$comment: Capture settings, to be filled in and placed beside a capture's frame
WHY IT IS REQUIRED. Every duration, metre bound and angular relation in
the rule library is interpreted against these settings. A capture recorded
with other values still type-checks, still grounds, and still reports
verdicts — the verdicts are simply about a different world. `secondsToFrames
1` is 20 frames, which at 40 Hz is half a second, so a rolling stop
satisfies a one-second dwell rule and nothing in the trace reveals it.
exactly this block for captures it records. For a capture from elsewhere,
fill it in from how that capture was produced — never by guessing, and
never by reading it back off the frames, which do not carry it.
The four settings marked REFUSED are mirrored as constants in frozen Core;
carla/adapter.py rejects a capture that contradicts them. The rest are
recorded and warned about: they change which situations arise, not what a

$fields.capture_hz: REFUSED on mismatch. The simulator's own rate, not an SGG parameter: `world.settings.fixed_delta_seconds` inverted. Mirrored in Core/Scene.lean::captureHz, which every `secondsToFrames` multiplies by.
$fields.fixed_delta_seconds: REFUSED. Must satisfy capture_hz * fixed_delta_seconds = 1, or one frame is not one simulation step and a frame count is not a duration at all.
$fields.abstraction: REFUSED. Only `process_to_junction_rsv` emits the entity and relation set Core/Scene.lean enumerates.
$fields.proximity_thresholds: REFUSED. The RSV keeps only the band LABEL, never the metres, so the mapping cannot be recovered from a capture. Different thresholds silently redefine every `Pred.withinMetres N`.
$fields.directional_thresholds: REFUSED. `Pred.oncoming`, `inFrontOf` and `behind` ARE these four arcs; a re-cut sector silently redefines in-front-of and behind.
$fields.proximity_relation_classes: warned. A table missing a class means a rule binding that road user by proximity cannot ground, and reads compliant for want of evidence rather than because it is.
$fields.render_dist: warned. Actors beyond it are absent from the frame.
$fields.segment_length: warned. Sets lane-node granularity, and appears in the `controls`-edge test, so every governance edge inherits a tolerance derived from it.
$fields.check_occlusion: warned, and the most consequential for transfer: false means the graph contains actors the camera could not see. A rule validated on such a capture may be firing on a vehicle behind a building, and has no counterpart in video.
$fields.parse_junction_boundaries: warned. Changes which frames carry junction entities, so `Pred.inJunction` grounds differently.
$fields.capture_mode: `live` or `replay`. A CARLA recorder replay TELEPORTS actors instead of integrating physics, so get_velocity(), get_acceleration() and get_angular_velocity() all return zero while get_control() still returns the real inputs. Measured: 882 of 882 moving frames of HazardAtSideLaneTwoWays report a stationary vehicle.
$fields.dynamics_valid: false suppresses speed, accel and yaw_rate, which are then emitted as `unmeasured` -- a value Core/Decimal cannot parse, so every comparison over them reads false in both directions, which is what `we did not measure it` means. A fabricated 0.0 is NOT neutral: it makes speedLe, and therefore Pred.stopped, true, and 12 of the 24 rule files read stopped.
$fields.ego_log_frame_offset: frames added when indexing ego_logs.json, for a capture whose frame origin differs from its log's. carla_sgg's capture_sensor_data.py ticks the world 10 times to warm 5 sensors up AFTER replay_file() has started and takes start_frame after those ticks, while add_agent_delay re-bases the log to tick 0 -- so rsv/i.pkl is replay tick i+10 and the correct offset is +10. Verified by position, which both files record independently: mean error 3.45 m at 0, 0.039 m at +10, on all three logged captures.
$fields.exclude_ids: warned. Actors listed here are dropped from every frame with no trace in the capture, so a rule about them grounds zero times for a reason nothing records. The ego is always excluded by the generator itself.
